pageProps.title: Flamingo Place
pageProps.review: A review of Jeong Hae-yeon's mystery novel 'Flamingo Place', which provides the original fun and thrill of the mystery genre through a detective reminiscent of Higashino Keigo's Detective Kaga and an amazing twist composition that maximizes the unique charm of the novel medium.
pageProps.description: I never thought this happiness would last forever. But I never imagined an end like this.
pageProps.content:
## Review Highly recommended book! It's a book you definitely shouldn't be spoiled for, but I think I could have enjoyed it even if I had been spoiled. However, it's a waste to miss the thrill of facing the twist.
Personally, the detective in this book reminded me of Higashino Keigo's Detective Kaga.
This novel probably cannot be made into a visual medium. Fun that is possible because it is a novel! But the fun of this novel is not just because it's a ```twist mystery```.
